title: Temporal Regression-Based Model-Free Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
summary: To address the widespread sensitivity of surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor (SPMSM) sensorless control to motor parameters, this paper proposes a temporal regression-based model-free sensorless control (TFC) method. First, voltage integrals and current increments over consecutive short intervals are stacked to construct a finite window regression, in which the unknown stator inductance appears as a common scalar coefficient.
